identitySignals: The agenda names a fund held at The East Bay Community Foundation, Oakland, CA, matching the registered nonprofit East Bay Community Foundation (EIN 94-6070996, Oakland, CA) per ProPublica

OUSD board file 22-2959 describes the grantor as 'The Helzel Family Foundation Fund at The East Bay Community Foundation, Oakland, CA' giving $50,000 for literacy instruction at Life Academy; grant numbers (e.g. #20231239) match a donor-advised grant program

A separate private foundation, Helzel Family Foundation (EIN 94-2597088, Oakland), exists in ProPublica but is listed c/o EBCF and is not shown on the IRS current roster; it is unclear whether the OUSD grantor is that entity or a fund of EBCF
research.notes: The vendor named in the agenda is a named fund held at East Bay Community Foundation, not clearly a standalone legal entity. The separate Helzel Family Foundation (EIN 94-2597088) is a different registered entity, and it is ambiguous which one is the grantor. Because a profile of EBCF would describe the host organization rather than the named fund, and the identity is not confirmed as one organization, no profile is published.
